blocks: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:
Section 8604 of the Elections Code is amended to read:
A fee or charge shall not be required of a write-in candidate except in the case of a candidate for city office, as provided in Section 10228.
digest: Existing law prohibits the imposition of a fee or charge for a write-in candidate except in the case of a candidate for city office, as specified.
This bill would make a nonsubstantive change to the above provision.
label: Introduced
subject: Write-in candidates: fees.
title: An act to amend Section 8604 of the Elections Code, relating to elections.
